name: xray_chest
description: Order a chest X-ray to evaluate lungs, heart, mediastinum, and bony thorax. First-line imaging for respiratory symptoms, heart failure screening, and post-procedural assessment.

views.description: Number and type of views requested

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., cough, dyspnea, chest pain, line placement check)

when_to_use: suspected pneumonia or lower respiratory tract infection
congestive heart failure or pulmonary edema evaluation
assessment of central venous catheter or endotracheal tube position
blunt or penetrating chest trauma initial screening

examples.query: Patient has worsening shortness of breath and bilateral crackles on exam
Check placement of newly inserted PICC line
